## New

- **Fonts.** One font for your chats and one for the rest of the app. Built in: Atkinson Hyperlegible, Lora, Nunito, Lexend, Comic Neue, and your phone's own sans, serif and monospace. Or add your own .ttf / .otf file (Settings › Look).
- **App text size**, from 85% to 130%. Chat text keeps its own size under Customize chat text.
- **Write for me, on another model.** A reminder that it doesn't have to use your default model: Settings › Model › Write for me uses.

## Fixed

- Characters now go by the name they use in chat, the one `{{char}}` stands for, everywhere except Browse and the character's own page, which keep the bot's title. Before, refreshing your chats could swap the title back in, so names (and `{{char}}`) changed depending on what loaded last.

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.2.1.apk** below. It installs over 0.2.0 or 0.1.0 and keeps your chats and settings.
